summary: Oculis Holding AG filed a Form 6-K on November 3, 2026, containing unaudited third-quarter 2026 results (interim financials, MD&A, press release) and disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its Amended and Restated Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners LLC, expanding its at-the-market program to up to $125 million of ordinary shares sold at the company's discretion under its effective March 4, 2026 Form F-3 shelf. Swiss counsel VISCHER provided the share-issuance opinion. No price, premium, board recommendation or advisor opinion is stated. Mechanics: incremental equity overhang via open-market sales. Watch dilution pace and any acceleration in ATM usage.
